children: Motilal Oswal's research report on Exide

Exide’s (EXID) 2QFY27 PAT of INR3.9b came in above our est. of INR2.9b. Strong double-digit YoY growth was observed across key segments, which led to 20.3% YoY growth in revenues, beating our expectations. The outlook for the lead-acid business remains positive across the auto and industrial segments (excluding telecom). However, we remain cautious about the long-term returns from the lithium-ion business. Moreover, the stock, trading at ~21.3x/19.1x FY27E/28E EPS, appears fairly valued. We reiterate our Neutral rating with an SoTP-based TP of INR381. We value the core (lead acid) business at 14x FY28E EPS. We add a value of INR71 per share for the EV business (based on book value) and INR45 per share for its stake in HDFC Life.
